verdict.rationale: Box documents a dedicated Box AI API guide for asking questions, extracting metadata, and summarizing files stored in Box, covering request handling, input limits, and agent overrides. Changelog entries show new models being added, and there is a visual agent configurator plus documented workflows for extracting PDFs into metadata and answering over Hubs, which indicates a shipped surface rather than an announcement. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Box AI works as documented.
